dashboard.welcomeSubtitle: This is where rights holders are managed — voices and faces, rates, consent and settlement — and where the content that uses them is made. Create a product to produce, or sign up if it is your own voice or face you want to offer.
dashboard.step1Desc: Actors and voice owners live in the voice & face bank with rates, consent and statements.
dashboard.step2Desc: Video, articles and ads — with standard voices or a rights holder's voice.
dashboard.step3Desc: Every use of a managed voice is written to the ledger the moment it happens — ready for settlement.
